ranking_note: Authored from the before description at commit e4e24832f7, frozen before any rewrite; protocol per /playbooks:skill-authoring ## Measurement. Sibling attribution:setup is user-invoked only (disable-model-invocation: true), so it cannot compete and is not listed. The review plugin's doc-drift-detector is an agent, not a skill, so codebase-health:audit stands for docs-versus-code drift. The competitors live in other plugins, and plugin eval loads only this plugin, so near-miss negatives test that the skill stays quiet, not competitor wins.
